'''Ghost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Upon learning that [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] reports from officer [[Keeling]] were intercepted by a gang called the [[Krayts]] and was about to the highest bidder, he contacted an Imperial individual and provided him with the time and place at which the sales were about to take place. After the reports were recovered, officer Keeling transferred to Ghost his broker's fee.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghost appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa, who begins the quest "Let the Vendor Beware".
